purpose: Separated Spine animation art and clean scene plates

assets.name: symbols
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production cutout layer atlas for Spine 4.2 animation, The Gates slot. Reference image is the EXISTING symbols: match its exact polished gold, turquoise inlays and detailed jeweled style, not pixel art.
Create a single TRANSPARENT PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY 5 columns x 4 rows, equal sized cells, generous transparent margins, each isolated component fully contained in its cell. No labels, no letters, no backgrounds, no drop shadows. Individual components must be COMPLETE where formerly occluded, ready to overlap into the reference symbols. Use front-facing view. Each component centered.
ROW 1: (1) empty ornate oval GOLD GEM SETTING with completely transparent oval hole, (2) RED oval faceted gemstone NO FRAME, (3) BLUE oval faceted gemstone NO FRAME, (4) GREEN oval faceted gemstone NO FRAME, (5) PURPLE oval faceted gemstone NO FRAME.
ROW 2: (1) AMBER oval faceted gemstone NO FRAME, (2) guardian mask gold/turquoise FAN HEADDRESS AND SIDE PIECES, with empty central face area, (3) isolated golden GUARDIAN FACE including chin and forehead, NO HEADDRESS, (4) SUN MEDALLION outer ornate pointed gold rays and turquoise circular rim with empty circular center, (5) isolated gold serene SUN FACE disc NO RAYS.
ROW 3: (1) SACRED EYE gold diamond surround and blue corner jewels with empty horizontal eye shaped center, (2) separate BLUE EYE eyeball with iris and pupil, (3) gold RUNE CHALICE bowl only, including blue rune gems, no stem/base, (4) gold ornate CHALICE stem and foot only, no bowl, (5) blue/purple CRYSTAL ORB sphere only without stand.
ROW 4: (1) ornate golden CRYSTAL ORB pedestal and side claw supports with transparent empty space for sphere, (2) green WILD gold circular rim and pointed corner jewels, completely hollow center, (3) luminous green WILD inner swirling disc, no frame, (4) one very small pale-gold faceted highlight glint, (5) blue magical liquid wisp rising from a cup, no cup.
Keep transparent holes truly transparent. Separate all 20 parts, no assembled duplicate symbols. 2560x2048 landscape sheet preferred.

assets.name: flames
assets.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction. Production Spine flame layer atlas, matching the fire in these The Gates temple background references. Transparent PNG, EXACTLY 4 columns x 3 rows of isolated separated fire layers on transparent background, cells equal size, generous clear gutters. No braziers, no walls, no rectangles, NO LABELS. Photoreal flame detail like original reference, NOT cartoon vector flames. Each flame is complete and isolated, grows from its bottom edge, smoky feathered transparency.
Each row is one palette: row1 warm golden-orange fire (base/normal); row2 supernatural emerald green fire (super); row3 ruby scarlet fire (hidden).
Each row has four different assets: column1 broad LOW base fire glowing ember bed plume, column2 thin curling tall LEFT tongue flame, column3 thin curling tall RIGHT tongue flame, column4 translucent tall BACK plume with intricate fine wispy tendrils. These are animation LAYERS to overlap, not four complete bonfires. White hot centers, detailed licking tendrils, lower tongues, subtle soft glow only around flame. Transparent background true alpha. Keep margins around every part; 1536x1024.

assets.name: scene-base
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean background plate for layered Spine flame animation. Edit THIS exact temple scene. REMOVE only the actual tongues of flame and airborne sparks from the two big edge braziers and the two small braziers inside the doorway. Reconstruct the tiny portions of wall behind the removed flames. Braziers remain in identical positions and sizes, retaining hot glowing coals at the rim, all ambient fire lighting and reflected warm/green/red illumination remain unchanged. Preserve EVERY architectural detail, camera framing, open gate position, palette, image dimensions 1536x1024 and ALL other pixels. Do not repaint the temple, do not add doors, do not move anything. This is a surgical remove-fire edit, no design changes.

assets.name: presentations
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Deconstruct this approved The Gates bonus crest into SEPARATE fully isolated Spine animation layers, matching its detailed gold/black-stone Egyptian temple aesthetic. TRANSPARENT PNG sprite sheet with exactly 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS of equal cells, at least 20px transparent margin in each. No labels. No complete assembled crests. Each part complete, not cropped.
ROW1: left gold falcon wing without head; right gold falcon wing without head; wide horizontal ornate gold-framed black stone EMPTY TITLE PLAQUE with no letters or wings; isolated circular gold sunburst crest socket with empty transparent center and NO wings.
ROW2: four isolated gold engraved 3D WORD-ART titles, exactly: "NORMAL BONUS", "SUPER BONUS", "HIDDEN BONUS", "BONUS COMPLETE". Titles are typography only on true transparent background, no plate or rim. Keep each single-line, readable and fully inside its own cell.
ROW3: circular cyan faceted gem; circular emerald green faceted gem; circular ruby red faceted gem; circular golden amber faceted gem. NO settings, gems only.
Highly polished detailed gold, bevels, blue/green/red jewels. TRUE transparent alpha around every separate sprite. All parts distinct, no overlap, equal 4x3 cell grid. Landscape 2048x1536.
